terms.register: vōx sermōnis cotīdiānī: Plaut., Ter.; Cic.

terms.gloss: of course, to be sure, naturally
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 3.49: nempe eam dīcit, in quā virtūtis nūlla pars īnsit (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Confirms what cannot be disputed, often ironically. In Plautus the word is often scanned as two short syllables.

evidence: Ter. Eun. 2.3.69: Estne, ut fertur, fōrma? — Sānē. (Lewis & Short s.v. sānus)

phrases.english: Do you know him? — Of course. — Like I know you.
